data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD6: Two synthetic fixtures \xe2\x80\x94 (a) 7000+ line direct PR with mixed reviewable/ignored files produces aggregated findings with visibility trailer, LLM never receives full diff; (b) 200-file synthetic PR routes to admin/FP-recovery without silent passing.

## Implementation Notes
Create `tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_large_diff_e2e.py`:

**Fixture (a) — 7000+ line PR**:
- Synthesize a fake PR diff with 25 reviewable .py files (totaling 5000 lines) + 5 ignored files (package-lock.json + .gitattributes-tagged generated files, totaling 2500 lines)
- Mock the LLM dispatch to capture invocations
- Assert:
  1. Pre-filter excludes the 5 ignored files (reviewable count == 25)
  2. region_split + Strategy F produces multiple clusters (likely chunked per-directory or per-file)
  3. Aggregator is called exactly once, receives ALL cluster results
  4. Final PR comment contains the visibility trailer with all 25 files listed as reviewed + 5 as skipped (with reasons)
  5. The LLM was NEVER called with the full 7500-line diff in a single call

**Fixture (b) — 200-file PR**:
- Synthesize 200 small files (1 line each)
- Assert:
  1. Pre-filter passes all 200 through (no linguist tags)
  2. Hard bound check triggers OVER_BOUND status (assuming max_files=100 or similar)
  3. PR comment contains 'OVER_BOUND' marker
  4. NO reviewers were dispatched
  5. /dso:fp-recovery rejects the PR with OVER_BOUND (calls T8's tested rejection logic)

Add .test-index RED marker `[test_dso_ci_review_large_diff_e2e]`.

## File Impact
| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_large_diff_e2e.py` | create | (this IS the test) | needs-creation |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | marker |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=\$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "\$TEST_CMD" ] && \$TEST_CMD
- [ ] E2E test exists
  Verify: test -f tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_large_diff_e2e.py
- [ ] Test asserts LLM never receives full 7000-line diff
  Verify: grep -qE 'never.*full diff|max_input_size|full_diff_assert' tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_large_diff_e2e.py
- [ ] Test asserts OVER_BOUND on 200-file PR
  Verify: grep -q 'OVER_BOUND' tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_large_diff_e2e.py
- [ ] After T6+T7, test passes
  Verify: pytest tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_large_diff_e2e.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); escalate.
